browser.lostText_other: No extension has written for {{count}} days. Open your browser and check that Koona Pin is enabled — queued links will arrive on their own.

browser.updateAppText: {{browser}} has a newer extension ({{version}}). Update Koona Pin — links wait in the extension until then.
browser.problem_channel: Koona Pin couldn't open its capture channel: another program holds it. Restart Koona Pin — links will wait in the extension.
browser.problem_registration: Koona Pin couldn't register with the browsers. Try again; if it fails, reinstall Koona Pin — links will wait in the extension.
browser.problem_host_missing: Part of Koona Pin (koonapin-host.exe) is missing. Reinstall Koona Pin — links will wait in the extension.

browser.banner_registration: The browser can't send bookmarks: Koona Pin couldn't register with the browsers. Links are waiting in the extension.
browser.banner_host_missing: The browser can't send bookmarks: part of Koona Pin is missing. Links are waiting in the extension.
browser.unavailableTitle: Saving from the browser isn't available yet
browser.unavailableText: This build of Koona Pin for Linux doesn't receive links from the browser yet. Saved links wait in the extension and arrive after an update.
browser.problem_channel_linux: Koona Pin couldn't open its capture channel: another copy of Koona Pin is using it. Close that copy and try again — links will wait in the extension.
browser.problem_registration_linux: The browsers can't find Koona Pin: its browser files are missing or damaged. Reinstall the koonapin package — links will wait in the extension.
browser.problem_host_missing_linux: Part of Koona Pin (koonapin-host) is missing. Reinstall the koonapin package — links will wait in the extension.
browser.banner_registration_linux: The browser can't send bookmarks: Koona Pin's browser files are missing. Links wait in the extension.

import.title: Import bookmarks
import.lead: Export bookmarks from Chrome, Edge or Firefox as HTML and pick the file. Links you already have stay as they are.
import.empty: This file has no bookmarks. Export them from the browser as HTML: in Chrome and Edge, Bookmark manager → ⋯ → Export bookmarks; in Firefox, Bookmarks → Manage bookmarks → Import and Backup → Export Bookmarks to HTML.
import.destinationHint: Library: sorted right away. Inbox: they wait to be sorted, behind the links saved from the browser.
import.rule: Top-level folders become collections, nested folders become tags. Bookmarks bar, Other bookmarks and Mobile are not folders of their own: their links get no collection.
import.progressNote: You can keep working. Nothing is saved until the whole file is in: an error leaves the library as it was.
import.existing: Already in the library — left as they were
import.reason_not_web: Not a web address (javascript:, place:, file:)
import.failed: Couldn't import. {{reason}} Nothing was added — the library is as it was.

export.diskFull: Couldn't save {{name}}: the disk is full. Nothing was written.
export.noPermission: Couldn't save to {{folder}}: no permission to write there. Choose another folder.
export.inUse: Couldn't save {{name}}: another program has it open. Close it and try again.

restore.title: Restore from a JSON copy
restore.lead: Pick a JSON copy made by Export. The file is checked in full before anything in the library changes.
restore.checkedBad: Checked: the copy can't be restored
restore.mergeHint: Adds what the library doesn't have. Bookmarks already here stay exactly as they are.
restore.replaceHint: The library becomes the copy. A backup of the current library is saved first.
restore.confirmText_one: The library has {{count, number}} bookmark now; after the restore it will hold the {{copy}} of the copy. A backup of the current library is saved first. {{undo}} can't undo this.
restore.confirmText_other: The library has {{count, number}} bookmarks now; after the restore it will hold the {{copy}} of the copy. A backup of the current library is saved first. {{undo}} can't undo this.
restore.added_one: {{count, number}} bookmark added from the copy
restore.added_other: {{count, number}} bookmarks added from the copy
restore.backupFailed: Couldn't save a backup of the current library: {{detail}}. Nothing was changed.
restore.notJson: This isn't a JSON file. Pick a copy made by Koona Pin's Export. Nothing was changed.
restore.notOurs: This isn't a Koona Pin copy: the file has no Koona Pin format. Nothing was changed.
restore.newer: The copy was made by a newer Koona Pin (format {{version}}). Update the app to restore it. Nothing was changed.
restore.damaged: The copy is damaged: {{what}}. Nothing was changed.

confirm.emptyTrashText_other: {{count}} bookmarks will be deleted for good. This can't be undone, and they won't come back with Restore.
confirm.deleteForeverText: «{{title}}» will be deleted for good. This can't be undone.

assistants.allow: Let AI assistants use your library
assistants.offHint: Claude, Cursor and other MCP apps on this computer can search your bookmarks
assistants.lastToday: On · last request from {{client}} today at {{time}}
assistants.lastOn: On · last request from {{client}} on {{date}} at {{time}}

assistants.addHint: Also add links to Inbox, tag them, move them to a collection and mark favorites. {{undo}} undoes each change; nothing is deleted
assistants.connectHint: Claude Desktop, Claude Code, ChatGPT and other apps that work with MCP

assistant.title: Connect an AI assistant
assistant.lead: Let an assistant search your library
assistant.statusOff: Off: assistants get an error until you turn it on in Settings
assistant.installTitle: Save Koona Pin for Claude Desktop
assistant.installText: Then double-click the file, drag it into the Claude Desktop window, or open Settings → Extensions → Advanced settings → Install Extension… in Claude Desktop.
assistant.saved: {{name}} is saved: open it in Claude Desktop
assistant.askText: For example: «find my article about FTS5». Claude asks before it uses a tool for the first time.
assistant.manualText: Settings → Developer → Edit Config, then add to claude_desktop_config.json:
assistant.runText: Adds Koona Pin for every project of this user:
assistant.checkText: Type /mcp in Claude Code: koona-pin shows «connected».
assistant.chatgptTitle: Add it in the ChatGPT app
assistant.chatgptText: Settings → MCP servers → Add server: name koona-pin, type STDIO, and this command:
assistant.codexText: Codex CLI shares the list of servers with the ChatGPT app:
assistant.chatgptNote: Needs the current ChatGPT desktop app; ChatGPT in the browser connects only to remote servers.
assistant.customText: Cursor, Windsurf, Zed and most other apps that work with MCP keep their servers in a JSON file.
assistant.customAddText: Some apps name the top key «servers». The app then lists koona-pin with its tools.
assistant.note: Titles, descriptions and notes reach the assistant as data. It cannot delete bookmarks or empty the trash.

connect.title: Connect browser
connect.install_chrome: Open chrome://extensions, turn on Developer mode, choose «Load unpacked» and pick the release/dev/chrome folder.
connect.install_edge: Open edge://extensions, turn on Developer mode, choose «Load unpacked» and pick the release/dev/edge folder.
connect.install_firefox: Open about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox, choose «Load Temporary Add-on…» and pick release/koonapin-firefox.xpi. Until the signed version, Firefox removes it when it closes.
connect.store_chrome: Open the Koona Pin page in the Chrome Web Store and click «Add to Chrome».
connect.store_edge: Open the Koona Pin page in Edge Add-ons and click «Get».
connect.install_safari: It comes with Koona Pin. In Safari, open Settings → Extensions and turn on Koona Pin.
connect.pin_chrome: Open the puzzle-piece menu on the toolbar and pin Koona Pin.
connect.pin_edge: Open the Extensions menu on the toolbar and choose «Show in toolbar» for Koona Pin.
connect.pin_firefox: Open the Extensions menu on the toolbar and choose «Pin to Toolbar» for Koona Pin.
connect.pin_safari: Still in Extensions, click «Edit Websites…» and choose «Allow» for other websites. Its button appears on the toolbar.
connect.save: Click the icon on any page. If Koona Pin is closed, it starts in the tray and saves the link.
connect.store_firefox: Open the Koona Pin page on Firefox Add-ons and click «Add to Firefox».
connect.site_firefox: Open the downloads page on koona.app in Firefox and click «Add to Firefox» under «Browser extension»; Firefox asks to confirm. If the page opens in another browser, open it in Firefox.
connect.save_background: Click the icon on any page. If Koona Pin is closed, it starts in the background and saves the link.
connect.save_menubar: Click the button on any page. If Koona Pin is closed, it starts in the menu bar and saves the link.
connect.snapFirefox: Firefox from Snap, Ubuntu's default, asks on the first save whether Koona Pin may run. Choose «Allow» — it asks once.
connect.sandboxTitle: Browsers from Flatpak and Chromium from Snap
connect.sandboxText: A browser installed from Flatpak, and Chromium from Snap, can't reach Koona Pin: their sandbox keeps the app out. Use the browser from your distribution's packages or the vendor's site. Firefox from Snap works.
connect.lost_chrome: Make sure the extension is on in chrome://extensions. Links wait in the extension and arrive by themselves.
connect.lost_edge: Make sure the extension is on in edge://extensions. Links wait in the extension and arrive by themselves.
connect.lost_firefox: Make sure the extension is on in about:addons. Links wait in the extension and arrive by themselves.
connect.lost_safari: Make sure Koona Pin is on in Safari → Settings → Extensions. Links wait in the extension and arrive by themselves.
connect.update_chrome: Rebuild the extension and click «Reload» on chrome://extensions. A store version updates by itself.
connect.update_edge: Rebuild the extension and click «Reload» on edge://extensions. A store version updates by itself.
connect.update_firefox: Rebuild the extension and load the new release/koonapin-firefox.xpi. A signed version updates by itself.
connect.updateSite_firefox: The extension updates by itself: Firefox checks koona.app for a new version once a day.
connect.update_safari: The extension updates with Koona Pin: each new version of the app brings it.
connect.updateStore: The extension from the store updates by itself: the browser checks for updates several times a day.

backup.title: Restore from a backup
backup.lead: Pick a copy. The library goes back to how it was then; changes made after it are lost.
backup.empty: No backups in the backups folder yet. Koona Pin makes one when it starts and once a day; a copy saved elsewhere can be chosen as a file.
backup.confirmText_one: The library has {{count}} bookmark now; the copy holds {{copy}}. Everything changed after {{when}} will be lost. A backup of the current library is saved first. {{undo}} can't undo this.
backup.confirmText_other: The library has {{count}} bookmarks now; the copy holds {{copy}}. Everything changed after {{when}} will be lost. A backup of the current library is saved first. {{undo}} can't undo this.
backup.confirmClosed: The library that didn't open is moved to the backups folder as it is, and the copy with {{copy}} takes its place.
backup.journalCleared: Undo history was cleared: it pointed to the replaced library.
backup.checkedBad: Checked: the copy can't be restored
backup.notDatabase: This file isn't a database, so it can't be a Koona Pin backup. Nothing was changed.
backup.notOurs: This file belongs to another program, not Koona Pin. Nothing was changed.
backup.newer: A newer Koona Pin made this copy (schema {{schema}}). Update the app to restore it. Nothing was changed.
backup.damaged: The copy is damaged: {{detail}}. Nothing was changed.
backup.unreadable: The copy can't be read: {{detail}}. Nothing was changed.
backup.backupFailed: Couldn't save a backup of the current library: {{detail}}. Nothing was changed.
backup.failed: Couldn't restore the copy: {{detail}}. Nothing was changed.

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.note: Same page saved more than once: www, http, the final slash, #part and utm_ tags don't count. Merge keeps every note and tag.
duplicates.afterTrash_one: the other one goes to Trash for 30 days
duplicates.afterTrash_other: the other {{count}} go to Trash for 30 days
duplicates.emptyText: Bookmarks saved more than once will show up here. Nothing is merged until you choose.
duplicates.confirmText: {{from}} bookmarks become {{to}}. Notes, tags and stars move to the main ones; the other {{trashed}} go to Trash for 30 days. {{undo}} undoes it.
duplicates.changed: The group changed meanwhile. It is shown again as it is now.

links.title: Link check
links.introText_one: Koona Pin opens the address of your {{count}} bookmark once, like a browser, without loading the page. The site sees an ordinary request from your computer. You can keep working or stop at any time.
links.introText_other: Koona Pin opens the address of each of your {{count}} bookmarks once, like a browser, without loading the page. Each site sees an ordinary request from your computer. You can keep working or stop at any time.
links.introSmall: Nothing is deleted on its own. Links to this computer or your local network are not requested.
links.stopped: Stopped at {{done}} of {{total}}. What was found so far is kept below.
links.offline: No internet connection. The check paused at {{done}} of {{total}}; links it couldn't reach are not marked.
links.local_one: {{count}} on this computer or local network was not requested
links.local_other: {{count}} on this computer or local network were not requested
links.footer_gone: The site answered 404 or 410: the page is no longer there. Nothing is deleted on its own; Trash keeps bookmarks for 30 days.
links.footer_moved: The page moved for good (301 or 308) and opens at the new address. Replacing keeps notes, tags and collection; {{undo}} undoes it.
links.footer_failed: Not counted as broken: a site can be down for a while or refuse automatic requests. Check again later or open it yourself.
links.replacedSome_one: {{count}} address replaced · {{skipped}} not: the new address is already saved
links.replacedSome_other: {{count}} addresses replaced · {{skipped}} not: the new address is already saved
links.notReplaced: Not replaced: the new address is already in your library
links.writeFailed: The check stopped: {{reason}}. What it found before is kept.
links.finished_one: Link check finished: {{count}} link needs a look
links.finished_other: Link check finished: {{count}} links need a look

background.title: Koona Pin keeps running
background.text: This desktop has no tray icon, so closing the window only hides it. Links from the browser keep arriving. To open the window again, start Koona Pin from the app menu.
background.hint: To quit, press {{quit}} or choose Quit in Settings. To see the icon in the top bar, turn on the AppIndicator extension in Extensions.

settings.copySaveFailed: Couldn't save the backup {{name}}: {{detail}}. Nothing was written.
settings.restoreHint: The library goes back to how it was in the copy
settings.backupNote: A backup is the whole library exactly as it was, for Koona Pin — restore it after damage or a mistake. To move bookmarks into another library, use Export → JSON; HTML is for browsers, CSV for spreadsheets.
settings.searchIndexHint: Rebuild it if search misses a bookmark that is in the library
settings.upToDateToday: Up to date · checked today at {{time}}
settings.checkFailed: Couldn't check: no connection. Koona Pin tries again tomorrow.

notice.previewUnchanged: Nothing new on the page — the preview stays
notice.copyFailed: Copying is unavailable. Select the text by hand.
notice.linkExisting: This link is already in the library; nothing changed
notice.restoredLink: Back from Trash, waiting in Inbox
notice.emptied_one: Trash emptied: {{count}} bookmark deleted for good
notice.emptied_other: Trash emptied: {{count}} bookmarks deleted for good

triage.title: Sort inbox
triage.fileHint: Or file it right away — press a number
triage.suggestedWhy: Links from {{domain}} mostly live in «{{name}}»: {{count}} of {{filed}}
triage.keys: Z — undo   ·   Space — open page   ·   E — edit
triage.trashNote: Trash keeps deleted items for 30 days
triage.trashNoteHint: Toss freely — everything can be restored.
triage.summary_one: {{count}} bookmark decided: {{kept}} kept, {{filed}} filed into collections, {{trashed}} moved to trash.
triage.summary_other: {{count}} bookmarks decided: {{kept}} kept, {{filed}} filed into collections, {{trashed}} moved to trash.

undo.gone: Not undone: «{{title}}» was deleted for good
undo.no_collection: Not undone: the collection of «{{title}}» is gone

trash.note: Deleted bookmarks stay here for 30 days, then they're gone for good. Restore brings one back with its note, tags, collection and star.

empty.libraryHint: Import bookmarks from your browser, connect the extension or add a link by hand.
empty.local: The library is stored only on this computer.
empty.noResultsHint: Try another query or clear the filters.
empty.noFavoritesHint: Mark a bookmark with the star — it will appear here.
empty.readingHint: Select bookmarks and press R, or choose «Send to Reading» in a bookmark's menu. Read ones leave after a week.
empty.emptyCollectionHint: Add a link here or move bookmarks from the library.
empty.searchHint: Search covers titles, addresses, descriptions, notes and tags. Check the spelling or try part of a word.
empty.inboxHint: New bookmarks from the browser and imports land here and wait for a decision.
empty.trashHint: Deleted bookmarks stay here for 30 days, then they're gone for good.

inbox.banner_one: {{count}} new bookmark is waiting — keeping, filing or tossing it takes a moment
inbox.banner_other: {{count}} new bookmarks are waiting — keeping, filing or tossing them takes about a minute
inbox.bannerImported_one: {{count}} new bookmark is waiting — from the import
inbox.bannerImported_other: {{count}} new bookmarks are waiting — {{imported, number}} of them from the import

failure.title: This page can’t be shown here
failure.refused: The address leads into a private network, so it was not opened.
failure.timeout: The site took too long to answer.
failure.network: The site could not be reached.
failure.status: The site answered with error {{status}} — it may let only browsers in.
failure.notHtml: This link is a file, not a web page.
failure.links: The page is mostly links, not an article.
failure.empty: No article was found on the page — it may be drawn by scripts.

readingMode.label: Reading mode
readingMode.failedTitle: Can’t show this page in reading mode
readingMode.failedTail: It opens fine in your browser, and the queue stays here.
readingMode.offlineText: Reading mode loads the page from {{site}}. Koona Pin tries again as soon as the computer is back online.
readingMode.emptyHint: Press R on a bookmark or choose «Send to Reading» in its menu. The browser extension can save straight to Reading.

library.damaged: The library is damaged, so changes aren't saved and links from the browser wait in the extension. Restore the latest good copy.
library.damagedLatest: The library is damaged, so changes aren't saved and links from the browser wait in the extension. Restore the latest good copy — {{when}}.
library.movedAside: The library of an earlier test build does not fit the new schema. It was kept as {{path}} and a new library was created.

gate.reportFailed: Could not copy. Select the report text manually.

DB_LOCKED.title: The library is in use by another program
DB_LOCKED.body: Another program has the library file open. Koona Pin has not written anything to it — your data is as it was. Close that program and click Try again.

DB_NEWER_SCHEMA.title: A newer version of Koona Pin has updated this library
DB_NEWER_SCHEMA.body: The library uses schema {{schema}}; this version supports up to {{supported}}. Install the latest version from koona.app/pin. The library has not been changed.

DB_FOREIGN.title: This is not a Koona Pin library
DB_FOREIGN.body: The file was created by another program. Koona Pin does not open or change it. Move the file out of the data folder and a new library will be created on the next start.

DB_NOT_DATABASE.title: The library file cannot be read
DB_NOT_DATABASE.body: The file is damaged or is not a database. Koona Pin does not change it. Restore the latest backup: the file is kept in the backups folder as it is.

DB_CORRUPT.title: The library is damaged
DB_CORRUPT.body: The integrity check found errors in the library file. To avoid further damage, Koona Pin does not update or change it. Restore the latest backup: the damaged file is kept in the backups folder as it is.

BACKUP_FAILED.title: Could not back up the library before updating it
BACKUP_FAILED.body: {{detail}}. Your data has not been changed.

MIGRATION_FAILED.title: Could not update the library
MIGRATION_FAILED.body: Your data has not been changed.{{backupNote}} The app does not use the library until the error is fixed: send the report to support.

DB_OPEN_FAILED.title: Could not open the library
DB_OPEN_FAILED.body: {{detail}}. Your data has not been changed.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.lead: Tell the developer about a bug, an idea or a question. Nothing leaves your computer until you press Send.
feedback.question: Question
feedback.placeholder: What happened, or what would you like?
feedback.attachHint: App and system versions, capture status and browsers. No links, titles, tags or notes.
feedback.reportFailed: The report couldn't be prepared — the message goes without it.
feedback.privacy: Stored in the EU for up to 12 months.
feedback.sentBody: The developer reads every message. If you left an email, the reply will come there.

update.title: Koona Pin {{version}} is available
update.current: You have version {{current}}. Your library, settings and browser connection stay as they are.
update.windowsHint: Koona Pin closes for a few seconds to install the update and opens again. Links from the browser wait in the extension.
update.linuxHint: Linux asks for your password to install the package, then Koona Pin restarts. Links from the browser wait in the extension.
update.hideHint: You can close this window: the download goes on, and the sidebar shows its progress.
update.passwordAsked: Linux is asking for your password to install the package.
update.closing: Koona Pin closes now and opens again in a few seconds.
update.installingKeep: Koona Pin restarts when it's done. If you cancel, version {{current}} keeps working.
update.keepsWorking: Version {{current}} keeps working, nothing was changed.

problem.no_connection: The download stopped: no connection to koona.app. Check the connection and try again.
problem.bad_signature: The downloaded file isn't signed by Koona, so it wasn't installed. Try again later.
problem.password_cancelled: The password wasn't entered, so the update wasn't installed.
problem.install_failed: Linux couldn't install the package. Download the new version from the site:
problem.failed: Something went wrong while updating. Try again later.

errors.disk_full: The disk is full — the changes were not saved.
errors.read_only: The library is damaged and open read-only — changes are not saved.
errors.database_busy: Another program is using the library. Try again in a few seconds.

reason.server_missing: part of Koona Pin (koonapin-mcp) is missing
reason.not_found: the collection or bookmark no longer exists
reason.not_in_trash: the bookmark is not in the trash
reason.unsupported_url: only http and https links can be saved
reason.copy_gone: the copy is no longer there
reason.message_too_long: the message is longer than 5000 characters
reason.invalid_email: the email address doesn't look right
reason.too_many_messages: too many messages from this network in the last hour
reason.proxy_failed: the network's proxy refused the request
reason.no_connection_or_proxy: no internet connection, or this network needs its proxy
reason.no_connection_or_system_proxy: no internet connection, or this network needs the proxy from the system settings
reason.update_needed: sync needs a newer Koona Pin

code.not_found: It no longer exists — it may have been deleted meanwhile.
code.invalid_request: The app did not accept this request.

detail.server_missing: Part of Koona Pin (koonapin-mcp) is missing. Reinstall Koona Pin.
detail.not_in_trash: This bookmark is not in the trash.
detail.invalid_url: That doesn't look like a link.
detail.unsupported_url: Only http:// and https:// links can be saved.
detail.copy_gone: This copy is no longer there.
detail.library_opening: The library is still opening. Try again in a few seconds.
detail.message_too_long: The message is longer than 5000 characters.
detail.invalid_email: This doesn't look like an email address. Fix it or leave the field empty.
detail.no_connection: Couldn't send: no internet connection. Your text is kept — try again, or copy it and send it another way.
detail.service_failed: Couldn't send: the server didn't answer. Your text is kept — try again later, or copy it and send it another way.
detail.too_many_messages: Too many messages from this network in the last hour. Your text is kept — try again later.
detail.proxy_failed: Couldn't send through this network's proxy: it asks for a sign-in or isn't reachable. Your text is kept — copy it and send it another way, for example on GitHub.
detail.no_connection_or_proxy: Couldn't send: no internet connection, or this network needs its proxy, which is set by a setup script the app can't use. Your text is kept — try again, or copy it and send it another way, for example on GitHub.
detail.no_connection_or_system_proxy: Couldn't send: no internet connection, or this network needs the proxy from the system settings, which the app can't read — it uses only the https_proxy and http_proxy variables. Your text is kept — try again, or copy it and send it another way, for example on GitHub.
detail.not_supporter: No Supporter has this email. Use the email from your payment.

supporter.title: Support Koona Pin
supporter.intro: Koona Pin stays free: the library, the browser button, search, backups and AI assistants. Supporters keep it going and get:

perks.sync: Sync between your computers — early stage, from day one
perks.backups: Automatic backups to a folder of your choice, like Dropbox
perks.reading: Paper and Sepia themes for reading
perks.badge: A Supporter badge in the app

supporter.paddleHint: Payment opens in your browser. Paddle handles it and the taxes as our reseller. Cancel any time: your library stays on your computer.
supporter.unreachable: Couldn't reach the Koona Pin server. Check the connection and try again.
supporter.waitingText: The payment page has opened in your browser. Koona Pin notices the payment by itself, even if you close this dialog.
supporter.thanksTitle: Thank you for supporting Koona Pin
supporter.thanksText: Supporter is active for {{email}}, the email from your payment. On another computer, open Support and choose «I'm already a Supporter».
supporter.paidSignInText: The email from your payment already has a Koona Pin account. Sign in with the code we send to it, and Koona Pin will show your plan here.
supporter.signInText: Paid on another computer? Enter the email from your payment and we'll send a 6-digit code — no password. Koona Pin then knows your plan here too.
supporter.noPlanText: You're signed in as {{email}}, but this account has no active Supporter plan. It may have ended or been cancelled.
supporter.planUnknownText: You're signed in as {{email}}, but your plan couldn't be checked right now. The app tries again within the hour.
supporter.planUnknownNotice: The plan of {{email}} couldn't be checked yet. Already a Supporter? Wait before buying again — the app tries again within the hour.
supporter.codeText: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it to sign in.
supporter.tooManyCodes: Too many tries for now. Wait a few minutes and try again.
supporter.alsoRenews: Your subscription still renews — cancel it in Manage
supporter.upgradeTextYearly: Pay {{price}} once instead of renewing. Your yearly plan stays until {{date}} and then stops renewing; the five years start that day.
supporter.upgradeTextMonthly: Pay {{price}} once instead of renewing. Your monthly plan stays until {{date}} and then stops renewing; the five years start that day.
supporter.upgradeHint: Payment opens in your browser. Paddle handles it and the taxes as our reseller. Supporter then lasts until {{date}}.
supporter.fiveYearsNotSold: Five years paid once aren't on sale right now. Your subscription goes on as before.
supporter.pastDue: The renewal didn't go through — update the card
supporter.unchecked: Couldn't check the plan — it stays on until {{date}}

sync.title: Sync
sync.perkOff: Koona's server keeps none of your library
sync.settingsOff: Off · keep your library the same on your computers

short.othersOffline: Waiting · your other computers are offline
short.waitingMain: Waiting for {{name}} to approve this computer
short.startedOver: Paused · sync was started over on another computer
short.stopped: Paused · open Manage to see why

setup.lead: This computer becomes the main one: only it adds and removes your other computers. Changes sync between all of them, main or not.
setup.leadJoin: {{name}} is your main computer. Turn on sync here, then confirm the code on {{name}}. Bookmarks on this computer stay and merge in.
setup.leadNeutral: With sync on nowhere yet, this computer becomes the main one and adds your others. Already on elsewhere? The main computer approves this one with a code.
setup.name: This computer's name
setup.privacyTitle: Encrypted on your computers before it leaves them.
setup.privacyText: Koona's server only passes it between your devices and keeps nothing of your library.

sync.addHint: Sign in with the same email there, then confirm the code here.
sync.onlyMain: Only the main computer adds and removes computers.

banner.mainOffline: {{name}}, the main computer, is offline. It catches up when it's back.
banner.connectingBody: Changes wait on this computer until it connects.
banner.pendingBody: Approve this computer on {{name}}, the main computer.
banner.offlineBody: Changes wait on this computer and go out when it's back online.
banner.othersOfflineBody: Changes wait here until one of them is online.
banner.clockBody: Set the right time to keep syncing.
banner.update: Update Koona Pin to keep syncing
banner.updateBody: Another of your computers has a newer version.
banner.planEndsBody: Supporter ends then. Your library stays here.
banner.planEndedBody: Supporter isn't active on this computer. Your library stays here.
banner.startedOverSomewhere: Sync was started over from another computer
banner.startedOverBody: Join again and your bookmarks merge back.
banner.revoked: This computer was removed from sync
banner.revokedBody: Its library stays here. Add it again to sync it.
banner.deviceLimitBody: Your account has as many computers as sync allows. Remove one on the main computer.
banner.replaced: Sync runs in another copy of Koona Pin
banner.replacedBody: Close the other copy, then try again here.
banner.signedOut: Sign in again to keep syncing
banner.signedOutBody: The sign-in of your Supporter account has expired.
banner.notReadyBody: Sync starts once the library is open.
banner.noServiceBody: Install Koona Pin from koona.app to sync your computers.
banner.askingMainBody: Allow it on {{name}} to make this the main computer.

problem.pairing_rejectedBody: Try again and check that both computers show the same code.
problem.pairing_bad_signatureBody: Someone may be in between. Try again on a network you trust.
problem.hub_offlineBody: Turn it on, or start over from this computer.
problem.untrusted_hub: This computer doesn't trust the main computer
problem.untrusted_hubBody: Its key is unknown here. Start over from this computer, or remove it there and add it again.
problem.not_allowed: Only the main computer can do that
problem.relay_refused: The sync server turned the request down
problem.peer_errorBody: If it keeps happening, copy the report in Details and send it to us.
problem.library_failed: Couldn't read or write the library
problem.library_failedBody: Check the disk has room, then try again.
problem.library_replaced: Sync stopped: the library was replaced
problem.library_replacedBody: A restored copy isn't synced yet. Add it again and it merges with your other computers.
problem.hub_change_deniedBody: The request to make this the main computer was denied there.
problem.hub_change_timeoutBody: Nobody answered within five minutes. Try again while {{name}} is on.
problem.stale_sign_inBody: Send a new code and enter it within ten minutes.
problem.key_lost: This computer lost its sync key
problem.key_lostBody: Its key file was damaged. Nothing new arrives until {{name}} is online and sends the key again.

pair.joinLead: Check that {{name}} shows the same code. Then it gets the key to your library.
pair.joinHint: Didn't ask to add a computer? Reject it. Your other computers are told either way.
pair.waitLead: Approve this computer on {{name}}. Make sure it shows the same code.
pair.waitHint: The library arrives here once it's approved. Your bookmarks on this computer are kept and merged.
pair.waitOffline: {{name}} is offline. It's asked again when it's back.

receive.hint: You can keep working; new links you save here are merged in.

sync.removeText: It stops syncing. Its library stays on that computer. Your other computers get a new key, so it can't read anything sent after this.

hubChange.title: Make {{name}} the main computer?
hubChange.lead: The main computer adds and removes the others. After this, {{hub}} is an ordinary computer and keeps syncing.
hubChange.hint: Didn't ask for this? Deny it and check your computers.

startOver.title: Start over from this computer?
startOver.leadDays_one: {{hub}}, the main computer, hasn't been online for {{count}} day. Starting over makes {{name}} the main computer and disconnects all the others.
startOver.leadDays_other: {{hub}}, the main computer, hasn't been online for {{count}} days. Starting over makes {{name}} the main computer and disconnects all the others.
startOver.lead: {{hub}}, the main computer, is offline. Starting over makes {{name}} the main computer and disconnects all the others.
startOver.keepText: Each computer keeps its library. Add them again and they merge back.
